columns.name: sku_family_id
columns.reason: Static product-family attribute known when the order is created.

columns.name: cube_utilisation_p50
columns.reason: Historical median cube-utilisation statistic, computed from past periods before the order.

columns.name: freight_class_code
columns.reason: Freight classification is assigned at order entry from product and shipping attributes.

columns.name: pick_sla_breach_flag
columns.reason: An SLA-breach determination on the same fulfilment clock that feeds the lateness call, so it encodes why the outcome was assigned.

columns.name: dock_dwell_p90
columns.reason: Percentile dwell statistic summarising prior dock performance rather than this shipment's realised dwell.

columns.name: wave_priority_code
columns.reason: Priority is assigned during wave planning, before fulfilment executes.

columns.name: pallet_pattern_id
columns.reason: Static packing-configuration reference for the item.

columns.name: sort_zone_code
columns.reason: Sortation zone is determined by routing rules at wave release.

columns.name: aisle_zone
columns.reason: Fixed storage-location attribute known before picking.

columns.name: delivery_scan_delta_h
columns.reason: Delta between delivery scan and promise exists only after delivery and is effectively the lateness measurement itself.

columns.name: conveyor_lane
columns.reason: Materials-handling lane assignment made during outbound routing setup.

columns.name: edi_partner_id
columns.reason: Trading-partner identifier carried on the inbound order.

columns.name: order_channel_code
columns.reason: Channel is recorded when the order is captured.

columns.name: outbound_volume_q1
columns.reason: Prior-period outbound volume aggregate for the account.

columns.name: trailer_door_id
columns.reason: Dock-door assignment comes from the outbound load plan, not from the delivery outcome.

columns.name: shift_code
columns.reason: Shift is fixed by the wave/labour schedule the order is worked in.

columns.name: insert_leaflet_code
columns.reason: Packaging-insert specification attached to the order or item.

columns.name: final_transit_hours
columns.reason: Realised end-to-end transit time is only known once the shipment is delivered and directly determines lateness.

columns.name: tote_type
columns.reason: Container type is chosen from order/item characteristics during picking setup.

columns.name: pallet_weight_kg
columns.reason: Physical weight follows from the order contents and packing, independent of the delivery outcome.

columns.name: bill_to_account
columns.reason: Billing account is on the order header at capture.

columns.name: origin_dock_backlog
columns.reason: Snapshot of current backlog at the origin dock, observable when the prediction is made.

columns.name: audit_sample_flag
columns.reason: Reads as a QA sampling selection made during processing rather than a post-outcome investigation, though the timing is not stated.

columns.name: carrier_cutoff_missed_flag
columns.reason: Records that the carrier cutoff was missed, a direct input to the late determination even though it is stamped before delivery.

columns.name: returns_prior_q2
columns.reason: Historical prior-quarter returns aggregate.

columns.name: order_line_count
columns.reason: Line count is fixed when the order is received.

columns.name: label_printer_id
columns.reason: Device assignment at the pack/label step, not derived from the outcome.

columns.name: customer_region_code
columns.reason: Ship-to region is known at order capture.

columns.name: pallet_licence_plate
columns.reason: Identifier minted at palletisation; an ID with no outcome content.

columns.name: packaging_class
columns.reason: Static packaging classification of the goods.

columns.name: promo_units_q2
columns.reason: Prior-period promotional volume aggregate.

columns.name: hazmat_class
columns.reason: Regulatory hazard classification is a fixed item attribute.

columns.name: pack_station_id
columns.reason: Workstation assignment during packing, independent of the delivery result.

columns.name: ship_complete_flag
columns.reason: Standard order-header requirement that the order ship complete, set at order entry, though a ship-confirm reading is possible.

columns.name: load_sequence
columns.reason: Position in the trailer load plan, produced by outbound load planning.

columns.name: route_wave_id
columns.reason: Wave/route identifier assigned when the order is released.

columns.name: expedite_fee_usd
columns.reason: Expedite charges are typically incurred as a reaction to an order running late, so the amount reflects the service failure.

columns.name: service_credit_usd
columns.reason: A service credit is compensation issued because the order was judged late; it is downstream of the target.

columns.name: outbound_volume_q4
columns.reason: Prior-period outbound volume aggregate for the account.

columns.name: outbound_volume_q2
columns.reason: Prior-period outbound volume aggregate for the account.

columns.name: carrier_account_id
columns.reason: Carrier account is selected as part of routing before dispatch.

columns.name: replen_shortfall_units
columns.reason: Inventory replenishment shortfall is an observable stock state at pick planning time.

columns.name: pick_path_metres
columns.reason: Computed from the pick plan and slotting before picking starts.

columns.name: outbound_volume_q3
columns.reason: Prior-period outbound volume aggregate for the account.

columns.name: returns_prior_q1
columns.reason: Historical prior-quarter returns aggregate.

columns.name: promo_units_q1
columns.reason: Prior-period promotional volume aggregate.
